title: Practice in the Hall
story: Rafi joined a small choir that meets on Thursdays. He did not know the new song, so he listened first. The leader asked him to sing the low part softly. Rafi marked the hard lines with a pencil. They recorded one verse on a phone to hear their mistakes. Rafi walked home humming the tune. He promised to practise before the next meeting.
